what: On first open, large three-digit number strips at the bottom right of an accent panel covering the screen roll for different lengths and stop at 00 → 100 — ones strip 2s after .4s, tens 1.3s after .8s, hundreds .8s after 1.2s, all on the same curve (0.327,0.007,0.327,0.96 — leaves slowly, passes fast, stops slowly). Once all stop, it rests .6s, the number row exits upward in .4s, the panel fades in .4s (power3.out) then disappears and fires fx:done. Only once per session

options.to: Cell end number, default 100 — one strip per digit (the first digit goes 0 → that number, the others spin around once and land on their number)
options.durs: Duration per slot (s), from the first slot, default ”0.8,1.3,2”
options.delays: Delay per slot (seconds) — from the first slot, default ‹1.2,0.8,0.4›
options.hold · out · fade: Pause after all lines are set · numbers dropping out · plate blur (sec), default .6 · .4 · .4
options.every: If visit, opens every time, default is session (once per window)
options.--fx-bg · --fx-ink: Panel and number colors (via style), default var(--kf-accent) · var(--kf-ink)

note: A motion part makes the band. The panel covers the screen with position: fixed, so place it at the very start of the document. When it finishes, display: none

from.where: index.html·works.html·news.html .ms-loader (first-visit orange panel · original Start Pre-Loader — page-load_move is-1·2·3 · sessionStorage visited)
